items.title: Q3 Earnings Results Reconfirm Broad-Based Strength as Outlook Improves
items.summary: The Q3 earnings season has reconfirmed the broad-based strength that we have been seeing in recent reporting cycles. The revisions trend remains positive, with estimates for 2026 Q4 and full-year 2027 continuing to rise and overall painting a strong earnings picture.

items.title: Zelda remake becomes fastest-selling Nintendo Switch 2 game ever
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa reports on "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" selling 5.2 million copies in its first four days on Nintendo (NTDOY) Switch 2, the device's fastest-selling game ever, ahead of next week's Grand Theft Auto 6 launch.

items.title: Nvidia and Alphabet Just Agreed to Buy $10 Billion Each of Anthropic Stock at Its IPO Price
items.summary: Anthropic's filing ties two of the seven checks to deals already in place -- though not the chipmaker's.

items.title: Fusion's Next Race Is Over Superconducting Tape, Not Plasma
items.summary: Proxima Fusion signed deals with Japan's Fujikura and Kyoto Fusioneering to build a European fusion supply chain, starting with superconducting tape.

items.title: Big Tech's expected big payday with Anthropic IPO, and Nintendo's big week with Zelda
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) oversubscribed IPO, how Jensen Huang's stance on China has evolved over the years, and Nintendo's (NTDOY) The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which has sold over 5 million copies.

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Hugging Face Co-Founder Thomas Wolf to talk about the company's best month in October, on controlling AI, and open-source models.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: GE Vernova Fell 25% on Data Center Fears. Only About 20% of Its Gas Turbine Customers Are Data Centers. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Investors may be viewing this company's future as being more dependent on the AI industry than it actually is.

items.title: Hugging Face co-founder says AI hacks show even the biggest labs haven't figured out AI alignment
items.summary: Hugging Face cofounder Thomas Wolf says AI alignment is a key issue the company is focusing on following OpenAI hack.

items.title: Anthropic's Mythos claim may put Nvidia’s CUDA moat in a vulnerable spot
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa discusses an Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) claim that its Mythos model got Claude running on AMD (AMD) chips in about three days, raising questions about whether AI can erode the value of Nvidia's (NVDA) CUDA moat.
